entries.description: Install, configure and start building with NiceUI.

entries.description: Patterns for building trustworthy AI agent interfaces.

entries.name: AI Video Editor Landing
entries.description: A white, editorial landing page for an AI video editor: a working editor in the hero (transcript, dithered player, AI Director, multitrack timeline), live bento demos, dithered art, pricing and FAQ.

entries.name: AI Agent Platform Landing
entries.description: A framed, grid-lined landing page for an AI dev product: auto-advancing feature tabs, live agent demos, constellation, marquee testimonials, pricing and FAQ.

entries.name: SaaS Landing Page
entries.description: A premium SaaS product landing page with hero, features, pricing, testimonials and dither footer.

entries.name: Studio Landing Page
entries.description: A design studio landing page with editorial hero, selected work, process, pricing and dither footer.

entries.name: Wealth Landing Page
entries.description: A warm, editorial light-theme fintech landing page with bento features, sticky steps, pricing toggle and story carousel.

entries.name: AI Design Tool Landing
entries.description: A Figma-style landing page with a live, interactive canvas editor, AI generation, multiplayer, prototyping and Dev Mode.

entries.name: Social Scheduler Landing
entries.description: A warm, animated landing page for a social media scheduling app with real network logos, live composer previews, heatmaps and analytics.

entries.name: AI Data Company Landing
entries.description: A dark editorial landing page for an AI training data company with a dataset catalog, sample explorer, pipeline and compliance story.

entries.name: CRM App
entries.description: A complete CRM workspace with people and company tables, a deal pipeline, record pages with a timeline, tasks, notes, workflows, a dashboard and a command menu.

entries.name: AI Chat Assistant
entries.description: A complete chat assistant app with streaming, reasoning, web search, artifacts, image and video generation previews.

entries.name: Analytics Dashboard
entries.description: SaaS product analytics with KPI sparklines, revenue area chart, traffic donut, top pages, live visitors and activity feed.

entries.name: Finance Dashboard
entries.description: Personal and business banking with a balance hero card, income vs expense bars, spending categories, transactions and quick transfer.

entries.name: Infrastructure Monitor
entries.description: Cloud operations console with live CPU/memory/latency charts, service status grid, deployments, incidents, region latency and a log stream.

entries.name: Commerce Dashboard
entries.description: Store admin with sales KPIs, an orders table, best sellers, an animated conversion funnel, customer reviews and inventory alerts.

entries.name: AI Agent Console
entries.description: LLM ops console with token usage, model cost donut, agent runs table, a streaming live run trace, latency cards and prompt eval scores.

entries.name: Voice Orb
entries.description: A living gradient orb that breathes, listens, thinks and speaks with simulated voice amplitude.

entries.name: Message Bubble
entries.description: User and assistant chat bubbles with timestamps, read receipts and hover actions.

entries.name: Prompt Input
entries.description: An auto-growing composer with attachments, a model picker and a send button that morphs into stop.

entries.name: Streaming Response
entries.description: Assistant text that streams in word by word with a blinking caret and lightweight markdown.

entries.name: Code Block
entries.description: Syntax-highlighted code for assistant answers, with highlighted lines and multi-file tabs.

entries.name: Reasoning
entries.description: A collapsible thinking panel that streams the model’s reasoning with a live timer, then folds into “Thought for 6 seconds”.

entries.name: Model Selector
entries.description: A command-menu model picker with search, favorites, capability badges, context and price, and a detail pane.

entries.name: Context Usage
entries.description: A context-window meter with a segmented ring and bar, running cost, a warning near the limit and a compact action.

entries.name: Response Branches
entries.description: Regenerated replies you can page through, with copy, rate, feedback, share and read-aloud actions.

entries.name: Prompt Suggestions
entries.description: Starter prompts in category tabs for an empty chat, plus follow-up chips that cascade in after a reply.

entries.name: Todo List
entries.description: An agent plan checklist that progresses from pending to running to done with a live progress bar.

entries.name: Tool Approval
entries.description: A human-in-the-loop card that shows tool arguments and morphs into its resolved state.

entries.name: File Diff
entries.description: A unified diff with collapsible hunks, change stats and accept or reject actions.

entries.name: Tool Result
entries.description: Collapsible cards that summarize tool output with a status icon and live duration.

entries.name: Citations
entries.description: Inline numbered citation chips with hover source previews and a linked source list.

entries.name: Agent Terminal
entries.description: A terminal that types out an agent run log line by line when it scrolls into view, with replay.

entries.name: Diff Suggestion
entries.description: An inline review suggestion: removed lines swap for added lines with one Apply click, and back with Undo.

entries.name: MCP Tool Picker
entries.description: A searchable list of MCP servers with one-click install toggles and a live installed count.

entries.name: Parallel Agents
entries.description: Agents on a shared timeline that slide in and fill their progress bars as they scroll into view.

entries.name: Auto Feature Tabs
entries.description: Auto-advancing feature tabs with a glowing progress underline; each tab swaps in its own live content.

entries.name: Network Pulse
entries.description: A hub-and-spoke constellation with pulses travelling from the core to breathing nodes. Pure SVG.

entries.name: Browser Agent
entries.description: A computer-use view where an agent drives a browser, with a moving cursor, labelled targets and a synced step log.

entries.name: Deep Research
entries.description: A research run that plans, searches, reads and writes, with a climbing source count and a report card at the end.

entries.name: Agent Trace
entries.description: A run inspector with a collapsible span tree, a timing waterfall, and the input, output, tokens and cost of each span.

entries.name: Agent Flow
entries.description: A workflow canvas of agents and tools where you can drag nodes and run the flow to watch data move along the edges.

entries.name: Agent Task Queue
entries.description: An inbox for background agents with queued, running, review, merged and failed tasks, plus review and merge.

entries.name: Clarifying Question
entries.description: The agent stops to ask: options with descriptions, an “Other” answer, number-key shortcuts and an auto-continue countdown.

entries.name: Checkpoints
entries.description: A timeline of the checkpoints an agent saves before each edit, with files changed and a confirm-to-restore rewind.

entries.name: Memory
entries.description: What the assistant remembers, grouped and editable: edit inline, forget with undo, add a memory or switch memory off.

entries.name: Artifact Panel
entries.description: Chat beside a live artifact: the latest version streams in, Preview and Code views, versions with changed lines and copy or download.

entries.name: Command Composer
entries.description: A composer with a / command menu and @ mentions for files, people and docs, keyboard driven, with selections as chips.

entries.name: Answer Engine
entries.description: A search-style answer: source cards first, then a streamed answer with inline citations and related questions.

entries.name: Generative UI
entries.description: Tool calls that render interactive cards instead of text: weather, a stock chart, flight options and a calendar event.

entries.name: Chat Widget
entries.description: A support assistant launcher with an unread badge, quick replies, streamed answers and a hand-off to a human.

entries.name: AI Command Palette
entries.description: A ⌘K palette that runs commands and turns any question into a streamed AI answer with insert and copy actions.

entries.name: Code Interpreter
entries.description: A notebook-style run cell: highlighted Python, a live timer, stdout, a rendered chart and a downloadable CSV.

entries.name: Agent Handoff
entries.description: A multi-agent thread where a triage agent hands the conversation to specialists, showing the context each handoff carries.

entries.name: Plan Review
entries.description: An editable agent plan: rewrite, reorder, skip or add steps, request changes, then approve and watch it run.

entries.name: Knowledge Base
entries.description: Sources that index through upload, parse, chunk and embed, with a retrieval tester that scores and highlights matching chunks.

entries.name: Agent Builder
entries.description: A no-code agent builder with identity, instructions, model, tools, knowledge and creativity, beside a live test chat.

entries.name: Model Compare
entries.description: A blind side-by-side: two models stream the same prompt with live speed and cost, you vote, then their names are revealed.

entries.name: Agent Activity
entries.description: A live vertical timeline of what the agent is doing, with per-step elapsed timers.

entries.name: Agent Loading States
entries.description: Six loading indicators for agents: shimmer text, dot pulse, equalizer, orbit, skeleton and typing.

entries.name: Image Generation
entries.description: A prompt-to-image flow with progressive blur-to-sharp reveals and a 2×2 variation grid.

entries.name: Chat App
entries.description: A complete chat experience with a conversation sidebar, streaming replies and a rich composer.

entries.name: AI Sidebar
entries.description: A collapsible copilot panel beside a document, with suggestions that apply directly to the text.

entries.name: Record Table
entries.description: A spreadsheet-style record grid with sticky columns, typed cells, inline editing, keyboard navigation and bulk actions.

entries.name: Filter & Sort Bar
entries.description: Saved views, a step-by-step filter builder, sort chips and search over a list that filters live, with a save-view state.

entries.name: Pipeline Board
entries.description: An opportunities kanban with drag and drop between stages, column totals and weighted pipeline, and a celebration on Won.

entries.name: Deal Card
entries.description: An opportunity summary with a clickable stage stepper, win-probability ring, health, next step, buying group and an AI next action.

entries.name: CSV Import
entries.description: A four-step importer: drop a file, preview rows, map columns with confidence scores, review duplicates and invalid rows, then import.

entries.name: Person Profile
entries.description: A contact record header with quick email and call actions, plus a field list you edit inline: email, phone, title, city, tags and owner.

entries.name: Company Card
entries.description: A company record with domain, firmographics, an ICP-fit ring, people and open deals, and an Enrich action that fills empty fields with sourced AI data.

entries.name: Activity Timeline
entries.description: Everything that happened on a record, grouped by day: emails, calls, meetings, notes, stage changes and field updates, with filters and load more.

entries.name: Tasks
entries.description: Tasks grouped into overdue, today and upcoming, with assignees and linked records, an animated complete, and quick add that reads dates like “tomorrow 3pm”.

entries.name: Relation Picker
entries.description: A searchable multi-select for linking people, companies and deals to a record, grouped with avatars, create-new and full keyboard control.

entries.name: Email Composer
entries.description: A sales email composer with recipient chips, templates, highlighted merge fields, AI rewrites, scheduled send and open tracking.

entries.name: Email Threads
entries.description: A CRM inbox: threads linked to companies, people and deals, with unread states, search, a thread view and quick reply.

entries.name: Sequence
entries.description: An outreach sequence over days: email, LinkedIn, call and wait steps with live sent, open and reply rates.

entries.name: Sales Dashboard
entries.description: KPI tiles with sparklines, revenue against quota, a pipeline funnel and a rep leaderboard, switchable by period.

entries.name: Lead Score
entries.description: A lead score gauge with a hot, warm or cold label, the factors behind it, an AI explanation and a 30-day trend.

entries.name: Coverflow Carousel
entries.description: A 3D coverflow with side covers that turn away, mirrored reflections, drag or swipe with inertia, arrow keys and captions.

entries.name: 3D Ring Carousel
entries.description: Cards on a slowly turning cylinder: drag to spin it with momentum, click a card to bring it to the front, pause with one tap.

entries.name: Card Stack
entries.description: A swipeable stack of photo cards that tilt as you drag and fly out left or right, with keep and skip buttons, keyboard control and restack.

entries.name: Parallax Slider
entries.description: Full-width slides whose images travel slower than the frame, with large serif captions, segmented autoplay progress and pause.

entries.name: 3D Tilt Gallery
entries.description: A grid of cards that tilt toward the pointer with a moving glare and floating captions; click one to zoom it open from where it sits.

entries.name: Masonry Gallery
entries.description: A responsive masonry of mixed aspect ratios with tone filters, staggered reveals and hover captions.

entries.name: Lightbox
entries.description: A thumbnail grid that opens a viewer with zoom and pan, swipe, arrow keys, a filmstrip, a counter and a details panel.

entries.name: Bento Gallery
entries.description: An editorial bento grid with a featured tile; click any photo to swap it into the spotlight with a FLIP animation.

entries.name: Filmstrip Viewer
entries.description: A cinematic stage with crossfades and Ken Burns motion, a synced filmstrip, arrows and an autoplay progress ring.

entries.name: Hover Reveal List
entries.description: An editorial index where hovering a title floats its photo beside the cursor with spring motion and a clip-path reveal.

entries.name: Marquee Gallery
entries.description: Rows of images drifting in opposite directions that pause on hover and speed up when you scroll or drag.

entries.name: Expanding Panels
entries.description: A horizontal accordion of tall image panels: the active one opens with its caption and the rest show vertical titles.

entries.name: Before / After
entries.description: A draggable comparison slider between an original and an edited image, with keyboard control and tap-to-flip on phones.

entries.name: 3D Gallery Wall
entries.description: Framed artworks hung along a perspective wall; walk along it by dragging or with the arrow keys, and the focused piece steps forward.

entries.name: Scroll Stack
entries.description: Sticky image cards that pile up and recede as you scroll inside the gallery, with a live index counter.

entries.name: Button
entries.description: Five variants, three sizes, loading state, icon slots and a pointer-origin ripple on every press.

entries.name: Animated CTA Buttons
entries.description: Six attention-grabbing call-to-action buttons for hero sections, pricing pages and launch banners.

entries.name: Card
entries.description: A surface primitive with an optional cursor-follow spotlight and glowing border, driven by CSS variables.

entries.name: Tilt Card
entries.description: A 3D card that tilts toward the pointer with spring-smoothed rotation and a moving glare highlight.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.description: Pill and underline tabs with a spring-animated indicator measured from the active tab. Arrow keys supported.

entries.name: Switch
entries.description: A toggle with a springy thumb that stretches while pressed and a soft glow when on.

entries.name: Input
entries.description: Text field with label, hint, icon slot, password visibility toggle, focus glow and an error shake.

entries.name: Select
entries.description: A custom listbox with a spring dropdown, staggered options, keyboard navigation and an animated check.

entries.name: Combobox
entries.description: A searchable select that filters as you type and highlights the matched substring.

entries.name: Multi Select
entries.description: Pick several values as chips that pop in and collapse out when removed. Backspace removes the last chip.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.description: Checkboxes whose tick draws itself with an SVG stroke, plus an indeterminate state for select-all groups.

entries.name: Radio Group
entries.description: Card-style radio options with a springy dot, ring pulse and roving keyboard focus.

entries.name: Range Slider
entries.description: Single or dual-thumb slider with pointer dragging, stepping, keyboard support and a value tooltip.

entries.name: Animated Badge
entries.description: Status badges in five tones with pulsing live dots, a rolling counter and a shimmering “New” tag.

entries.name: Color Picker
entries.description: Saturation/value square, hue slider, hex input with copy and preset swatches, all draggable with the pointer.

entries.name: Animated Color Selector
entries.description: Swatch picker where the selected color expands into a pill with a check and its name.

entries.name: Table
entries.description: A data table with sortable columns, row selection, status badges, hover actions and pagination.

entries.name: Animated Breadcrumb
entries.description: Long paths collapse their middle into an ellipsis that expands with a staggered reveal on click.

entries.name: Adaptive Stepper
entries.description: A multi-step flow with filling connectors, check-morphing step nodes and direction-aware sliding content.

entries.name: Aspect Ratio
entries.description: Lock content to a ratio. Switching ratios morphs the frame with a spring.

entries.name: Date Range Picker
entries.description: Month grid with start/end selection, hover preview, quick presets and sliding month navigation.

entries.name: Animated Alert
entries.description: Status alerts with stroke-drawn icons and a smooth collapse when dismissed.

entries.name: Animated Collapsible
entries.description: A disclosure panel with grid-based height animation and blurred content reveal.

entries.name: Bouncy Accordion
entries.description: An accordion with spring-eased panels, a rotating plus icon and single or multiple open modes.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.description: Hover and focus tooltips with a spring scale-in, arrow, delay and keyboard shortcut hints.

entries.name: Popover
entries.description: A click-triggered floating panel that scales from its anchor with a spring.

entries.name: Animated Context Menu
entries.description: A right-click menu that opens at the cursor with staggered items, shortcuts and submenus.

entries.name: Morphing Modal
entries.description: Cards that FLIP-morph from their grid position into a centered modal and back.

entries.name: Center Morph Modal
entries.description: A pill button that morphs its size, position and radius into a centered dialog.

entries.name: Drawer
entries.description: A floating side drawer with a blurred backdrop, staggered content and Escape to close.

entries.name: Bottom Sheet
entries.description: A draggable sheet with snap points, rubber-banding and flick-to-dismiss physics.

entries.name: Animated Toast Stack
entries.description: Stacked toasts that fan out on hover, auto-dismiss with a progress bar and support promises.

entries.name: Text Animation
entries.description: Blur-in words, typewriter, scramble decrypt, rotating words and gradient sweep effects.

entries.name: Number Animation
entries.description: Eased number tickers and a rolling-digit odometer for currency, counts and percentages.

entries.name: Marquee
entries.description: Infinitely scrolling rows or columns with faded edges, reverse and pause on hover.

entries.name: Scroll Animation
entries.description: Scroll-linked progress, parallax layers and reveal-on-scroll, scoped to any scroll container.

entries.name: Loader
entries.description: Eight polished loading indicators, from spinners and orbits to shimmering skeletons.

entries.name: Theme Toggle
entries.description: A sun-to-moon morphing toggle and a three-way segmented control with a sliding pill.

entries.name: Action Swap
entries.description: Icon and label swaps for stateful actions: copy, follow, play and like with a particle burst.

entries.name: Expandable Control
entries.description: A compact now-playing pill that springs open into a full music player.

entries.name: Dock
entries.description: A macOS-style dock with distance-based magnification, tooltips, launch bounce and open dots.

entries.name: Animated Sidebar
entries.description: An app sidebar that collapses between 72px and 240px with fading labels and nested groups.

entries.name: File Tree
entries.description: A nested file explorer with animated expand/collapse, indent guides and typed file icons.

entries.name: Sortable List
entries.description: Pointer-driven drag reordering where siblings slide out of the way and the item settles into place.

entries.name: Shader Background
entries.description: A canvas-rendered animated gradient mesh with film grain, perfect behind hero sections.

entries.name: Cylinder Carousel
entries.description: A 3D rotating cylinder of cards built with CSS transforms, draggable and keyboard navigable.

entries.name: Wheel Picker
entries.description: iOS-style scroll-snapping wheels with 3D rotation and depth fade.

entries.name: Image Viewer
entries.description: A thumbnail grid that expands into a lightbox with click-to-zoom and keyboard navigation.

entries.name: Shared Layout Background
entries.description: A single highlight that glides between hovered nav or menu items.

entries.name: Morphing Search
entries.description: An icon button that springs open into a wide search field with a keyboard-navigable results dropdown.

entries.name: Command Palette
entries.description: A ⌘K launcher with fuzzy matching, grouped results, a spring-sliding highlight and keyboard shortcuts.

entries.name: Dynamic Island
entries.description: A black pill that morphs its width, height and radius between idle, call, music, timer and notification states.

entries.name: Notification Stack
entries.description: iOS-style stacked notifications that fan out into a list when tapped, and cards that slide away when dismissed.

entries.name: Infinite Masonry
entries.description: A balanced masonry grid in its own scroll container that streams in more cards with shimmering skeletons.

entries.name: Project Folder
entries.description: A 3D folder whose front flap tilts open on hover while the papers inside fan out with a spring.

entries.name: Card Folder
entries.description: A wallet of payment cards that fans out on hover. Pick one and it rises out of the pocket.

entries.name: Fixtures
entries.description: A sports scoreboard with day tabs, live match minutes behind a pulsing indicator and kickoff reminders.

entries.name: Availability Scheduler
entries.description: Set weekly working hours with day toggles and time ranges that animate as they are added or removed.

entries.name: Multi-chain Swap
entries.description: A token swap card with chain-aware selectors, a rotating flip control, live rate and fee, and a button that reflects every state.

entries.name: Expandable Action Bar
entries.description: A floating bar that springs up from the bottom when list items are selected, showing a live count and bulk actions.

entries.name: Overflow Actions
entries.description: A toolbar that measures itself and moves actions into a “more” menu as space runs out, with smooth width transitions.

entries.name: Expandable Tabs
entries.description: Compact icon tabs where the active one stretches open to show its label.

entries.name: Morphing Tabs
entries.description: A segmented control whose indicator stretches toward the new tab before settling, while the panels crossfade.

entries.name: Swipeable List
entries.description: Rows you can drag sideways to archive or delete, with rubber-band resistance, snap points and a collapsing exit.

entries.name: File Upload
entries.description: A dropzone with a glowing drag-over state, a real file picker, per-file progress and animated removal.

entries.name: Prediction Market
entries.description: A binary market card with a probability bar, an interactive SVG sparkline and a buy panel that calculates payout.

entries.name: Wallet Card
entries.description: A crypto wallet summary with a counting balance, a privacy toggle, inline send and receive panels, and an asset list.

entries.name: OTP Input
entries.description: A six-digit code input that advances automatically, supports paste and backspace, and shows verifying, success and error states.

entries.name: Sign Up Form
entries.description: A sign-up card with social buttons, inline validation, a live password strength meter and an animated success state.

entries.name: Bloom Menu
entries.description: A floating action button that opens into a ring or arc of actions, each arriving on its own spring with a stagger.

entries.name: Feedback Widget
entries.description: A small pill that grows into a feedback panel with a rating and comment box, then shrinks into a thank-you card.

entries.name: 404 / Not Found
entries.description: A 404 page with a layered “404” that follows the pointer, a periodic glitch, docs search and suggested links. This site uses it as its real 404 page.

entries.name: Pull to Refresh
entries.description: A mobile-style container you can drag down with rubber-band resistance to reveal a spinner and load new content.

entries.name: Hero — Aurora
entries.description: A slow, drifting aurora of sky, cyan and indigo light behind a serif-accented headline and an email capture with success state.

entries.name: Hero — Spotlight
entries.description: A dark grid lit by a mouse-following spotlight, with a headline that resolves word by word from blur to sharp.

entries.name: Hero — Split Product
entries.description: Copy and social proof on the left; a 3D-tilting stack of floating product cards — chart, notification, metric — on the right.

entries.name: Hero — Beams
entries.description: Light beams fall through a column grid behind an announcement badge, headline and a copyable install command.

entries.name: Hero — Orbit
entries.description: Integration icons orbit a glowing core on three concentric rings at different speeds, framing a centered headline.

entries.name: Hero — Rotating Word
entries.description: Editorial, oversized type where one word cycles with a blur-slide transition and a drawn underline.

entries.name: Feature Grid — Spotlight
entries.description: Six features in a hairline grid. A cursor-following spotlight lights each cell and traces its border; icons tilt and glow on hover.

entries.name: Bento Grid — Live
entries.description: An asymmetric bento where every tile is alive: streaming bars, a typing search, a rotating dot globe, cycling notifications, toggles and a shimmering code line.

entries.name: Logo Cloud — Marquee
entries.description: Two rows of wordmarks drifting in opposite directions with soft edge fades. Pauses on hover.

entries.name: Logo Cloud — Cycling Grid
entries.description: A 2×4 logo grid where cells take turns swapping brands with a blur crossfade, beside a short heading.

entries.name: Testimonials — Wall
entries.description: A masonry wall of quotes in three columns scrolling vertically at different speeds, with star ratings and faded edges.

entries.name: Testimonials — Marquee
entries.description: A large featured quote above two rows of compact quote cards gliding in opposite directions.

entries.name: Testimonials — Video
entries.description: Video testimonial cards with gradient posters and a pulsing play button that open an animated player with captions and progress.

entries.name: Pricing Tiers
entries.description: Three pricing tiers with a sliding monthly/yearly toggle, rolling-digit prices and a featured plan wrapped in a rotating glow border.

entries.name: Pricing Comparison
entries.description: A plan comparison table with a sticky plan header, grouped feature rows, a highlighted featured column and hover rows. Scrolls horizontally on mobile.

entries.name: Usage Pricing Slider
entries.description: Usage-based pricing: drag the slider and the price tweens smoothly, the plan badge switches and a cost breakdown updates live.

entries.name: FAQ — Two Column
entries.description: Heading and contact card on the left, an accordion on the right with smooth height animation and a plus-to-minus icon morph.

entries.name: CTA — Horizon
entries.description: A centred call to action over a faint grid, sitting on the signature glowing horizon arc.

entries.name: CTA — Grid Beams
entries.description: A newsletter CTA card with a drifting grid, light beams sweeping across and an email form with an animated success state.

entries.name: Footer — Mega
entries.description: A full footer with newsletter, link columns, socials and a live status dot, ending in a giant outlined wordmark that fills with sky light as it scrolls into view.

entries.name: Footer — Minimal
entries.description: A single-row footer with logo, underline-on-hover links, socials and a soft sky hairline on top.

entries.name: Changelog
entries.description: A release timeline whose dots light up as entries scroll into view, with tag chips, small visuals and New / Improved / Fixed filters.

entries.name: Team Grid
entries.description: Team cards with gradient portraits built from initials; hover slides up a bio and social links. Includes a “We’re hiring” card.

entries.name: Blog Cards
entries.description: A featured post plus a card grid with generated gradient cover art, category chips and read time; covers zoom and arrows slide on hover.

entries.name: Dither Dot Footer
entries.description: A footer with a fine dot dither pattern, CTA strip, link columns and status bar.

entries.name: Dither Grid Footer
entries.description: A footer with a grid dither pattern, newsletter signup and giant brand text.

entries.name: Dither Diagonal Footer
entries.description: A minimal footer with a diagonal line dither pattern and centered brand layout.
